dashboard_line: Phase 2 wired: context_pressure+phase_gate_prob; 21% baseline agree, bias fix needed

files_modified.changes: Added context_pressure(), phase_gate_probability(), log_phase2_shadow_to_session_metrics(); constants _CP_C_MID/_CP_K/_PG_*/PHASE_HARD_THRESHOLDS; wired into spawn_mode() (pressure log) and query_mode topology (phase_gate log)
Added _log_cp_entry() helper; wired into assemble_bundle() after f(0) log; logs context_pressure per spawn to session-metrics
New entry shape: phase2_shadow=true, type=context_pressure|phase_gate, formula-specific fields

implementation_notes.context_pressure_integration: spawn_mode() + assemble_bundle(); fill_tokens is proxy estimate (bundle_tokens for spawn_template, open_targets*500 for mission_graph); actual fill requires API response wiring in Phase 3
implementation_notes.phase_gate_integration: query_mode topology only; fires for tasks carrying quality_score+belief_index in manifests; future Phase 3 will wire into phase-advance check in regen_mode
implementation_notes.calibration_finding: default bias=-0.1 yields 21% overall agreement (all sig_more_lenient); per-phase bias [-0.35,-0.47,-0.555,-0.585] yields 75-93% agreement; T=10 recommended (sharp step matches hard threshold behavior)

disagreement_type_distribution.interpretation: sigmoid systematically more permissive than AND-logic hard thresholds; captures quality-belief trade-off that hard thresholds discard
